about: Request-room derivation vectors (spec 04 5.3, S1-SRV-02a step 3). roomId is the lowercase 8-4-4-4-12 hex of b, where b = SHA-256(utf8(floe-request-room-v1: + hostToken))[0:16] with b[6] = (b[6] & 0x0f) | 0x40 and b[8] = (b[8] & 0x3f) | 0x80. Generated by an independent Node one-liner from that formula, never from the Go or server code under test. Asserted by TestRoomIDFromTokenVectors (cli/engine/signaling) and by server test T27.
